comment: ANCHOR: DAILY_INCUBATOR_REFRESH_IDEMPOTENT_20261107 — LQ-20261107-128: a same-slot re-run of the
daily-incubator-refresh lane is write-once (the UPDATE carries a last_seen_at < date_trunc('day', NOW())
guard and a rowcount 0 skips the event insert), and a run whose scan-refresh pass was rolled back reports
scan_refresh_lost instead of produced = processed - no_data. Hermetic fake connections; no DB, no .env.
